name: agent-harness-marketplace
description: Modules that install natively on Claude Code, pi and dsh from one content tree.

plugins.name: plan-for-dummies
plugins.description: Write an implementation plan that a less capable model (Sonnet, Haiku, a cheap subagent) will execute without the planner present.

plugins.name: dual-agent-pr-review
plugins.description: Review a GitHub PR with Claude Code and Codex in parallel, then reconcile their findings into one consensus set.

plugins.name: agent-transcripts
plugins.description: Export Claude Code, pi and dsh transcripts into one on-device cache and index them in a derived sqlite database.

plugins.name: pr-flow
plugins.description: Work off main on every harness: branch + worktree, PR, watch CI until green, merge only when told, tear down after merge.

plugins.name: browser
plugins.description: Drive a browser from any harness: headless auto mode, headed hybrid mode where a human logs in and the agent takes over, or attach to a browser the user opened via its debug port — through agent-browser on a persistent per-identity profile.

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Guided seven-phase feature development: explore the codebase with parallel specialist agents, ask clarifying questions, compare architectures, implement, then review. A harness-neutral port of Anthropic's feature-dev plugin whose agents dispatch on Claude Code, pi and dsh.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated pull-request review on every harness: parallel reviewers from five lenses, confidence scoring that drops anything under 80, one comment posted with gh.

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Simplify recently changed code for clarity, consistency and maintainability without changing what it does, following the project's own guideline files.
